brief_description: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst generates high-quality images from text prompts, with five quality tiers and transparent-background support.
detailed_description:
# gpt-image-2.5-sunburst-generate API Usage Guide

## Overview

__gpt-image-2.5-sunburst-generate__ is OpenAI's GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst model — the most capable GPT Image 2.5 variant, tuned for the highest editing precision. It follows complex prompts, renders accurate text inside images, and produces photorealistic output across a wide range of styles.

GPT Image 2.5 ships as two sibling models at identical pricing: **sunburst** (most capable variant — highest editing precision) and **flare** (fastest variant — high-quality everyday generation). Both are available on GMI for generation and editing.

## Authentication

```bash
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

## Submit Request

### Endpoint
```
POST /api/v1/ie/requestqueue/apikey/requests
```

### Request Format

```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.gmicloud.ai/api/v1/ie/requestqueue/apikey/requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-image-2.5-sunburst-generate",
    "payload": {
      "prompt": "A photograph of a red fox in an autumn forest",
      "size": "1024x1024",
      "quality": "medium",
      "output_format": "png",
      "n": 1
    }
  }'
```

### Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Default |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `model` | string | Yes | Model identifier | - |
| `payload.prompt` | string | Yes | Text description of the image to generate | - |
| `payload.size` | string | No | `auto`, a preset, or a custom `WxH` | `"1024x1024"` |
| `payload.quality` | string (enum) | No | `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max` / `auto` | `"auto"` |
| `payload.n` | integer | No | Number of images to generate (1-10) | `1` |
| `payload.output_format` | string (enum) | No | `png` / `jpeg` / `webp` | `"png"` |
| `payload.output_compression` | integer | No | 0-100, only for `jpeg` / `webp` | - |
| `payload.background` | string (enum) | No | `transparent` / `opaque` / `auto` | `"auto"` |
| `payload.moderation` | string (enum) | No | `auto` / `low` | `"auto"` |

### Response

```json
{
  "request_id": "cd5b59d5-1b3f-4fd5-9899-15ecea1f28ba",
  "model": "gpt-image-2.5-sunburst-generate",
  "status": "success",
  "outcome": {
    "media_urls": [{"id": "0", "url": "https://storage.googleapis.com/..."}],
    "thumbnail_image_url": "https://storage.googleapis.com/..."
  }
}
```

## Capabilities

| Capability | Support |
|------------|---------|
| Quality tiers | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`, `auto` |
| Output formats | `png`, `jpeg`, `webp` |
| Transparent background | Supported (`background: "transparent"`, png/webp output) |
| Custom sizes | Multiples of 16, each edge <= 3840px, aspect <= 3:1, 655,360-8,294,400 total pixels |
| Batch generation | Up to 10 images per request via `n` |
| Multi-image input (edit) | Up to 16 input images |
| Inpainting mask | Supported; mask must carry an alpha channel |

## Pricing

Billing is based on the **actual token consumption** reported by OpenAI for each request. Users are charged according to the real usage of input text tokens, cached input text tokens, input image tokens, cached input image tokens, and output image tokens.

The final cost may vary depending on prompt length, whether input images are provided, image size, quality, number of generated images, and other request parameters.

### Token Pricing

Prices below are charged **per 1M tokens**:

| Token Type | Price |
|------------|-------|
| Text input tokens | $5.00 / 1M tokens |
| Cached text input tokens | $1.25 / 1M tokens |
| Image input tokens | $8.00 / 1M tokens |
| Cached image input tokens | $2.00 / 1M tokens |
| Image output tokens | $30.00 / 1M tokens |

### Billing Formula

```text
Total cost =
  (text_input_tokens × $5.00 / 1,000,000)
+ (cached_text_input_tokens × $1.25 / 1,000,000)
+ (image_input_tokens × $8.00 / 1,000,000)
+ (cached_image_input_tokens × $2.00 / 1,000,000)
+ (image_output_tokens × $30.00 / 1,000,000)
```

### Estimated Price Reference (per image)

The following table is provided as a **reference only** for common quality and resolution combinations. These are estimated per-image prices and may differ from the final billed amount, which is always based on actual token usage.

Note that the quality ladder differs from gpt-image-2: GPT Image 2.5 adds the `xhigh` and `max` tiers, and its `medium` and `high` tiers are substantially cheaper than the same-named gpt-image-2 tiers.

| Quality | 1024x1024 | 1024x1536 | 1536x1024 |
|---------|-----------|-----------|-----------|
| Low     | $0.006    | $0.005    | $0.005    |
| Medium  | $0.013    | $0.010    | $0.010    |
| High    | $0.053    | $0.041    | $0.041    |
| XHigh   | $0.094    | $0.074    | $0.074    |
| Max     | $0.211    | $0.165    | $0.165    |

## Check Request Status

```
GET /api/v1/ie/requestqueue/apikey/requests/{request_id}
```

## Pricing

Billing is token-based and fixed by size and quality; explicit tiers are priced exactly. quality=auto (or omitting quality) is billed at the max tier because its consumption adapts to the prompt and cannot be known in advance — pick an explicit tier for a predictable price.
pricing_details: Token-based; the pre-charge is the final price. Output at 1024x1024 per image: low $0.0059, medium $0.0132, high $0.0527, xhigh $0.0937, max $0.2107. Default quality is medium. quality=auto (or omitted) is billed at the max tier because its consumption adapts per request. Prompt text billed at $5/M tokens (~1 token per 3 bytes). Other sizes scale with pixel count.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Text description of the image to generate.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Output resolution. Accepts "auto", the presets 1024x1024 / 1024x1536 / 1536x1024, or a custom WxH where both dimensions are multiples of 16, each edge <= 3840px, aspect ratio <= 3:1, and total pixels between 655,360 and 8,294,400.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: Image quality level — affects detail and cost. GPT Image 2.5 supports five tiers plus auto.

parameters.name: output_format
parameters.description: File format of the generated image.

parameters.name: output_compression
parameters.description: Compression level 0-100. Only valid for jpeg and webp output.

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: Background handling. "transparent" produces an alpha channel and requires png or webp output.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Optional stable identifier for your end user, forwarded to OpenAI for abuse monitoring.
